item.title: Villanova Softball Goes 0-5 At Joan Joyce Classic

item.title: Women’s Basketball Dominates Seton Hall, 82-52, In Regular Season Finale
item.description: On Thursday, Feb. 26, sophomore guard Jasmine Bascoe scored 28 points to help Villanova women’s basketball to an 82-52 win over Seton Hall, in its final game of the regular season.
